data.description: Shark Hunt is a mission from the fishing villages, [Large Fishing Village](/monument/large-fishing-village) included, about killing the [sharks](/world/shark) threatening divers near the island. Search the dive sites for sharks, kill one, then speak with the dive master to turn it in. A shark has 148 HP, and the payout is a jackhammer, 3 [medical syringes](/items/medical-syringe) and 50 scrap. Fail and you can retry after 5 minutes, finish it and there's an 8-hour cooldown.
